usedFor: Sangam CRM holds opportunities and Slack holds team chat, so “Opportunity Created” can run “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “Opportunity Created” in Sangam CRM, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: The team sees each new opportunity in a channel instead of checking the CRM.

watchOut: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” in Slack includes bot messages, so watch which channel your own posts reach.
